scientific_status: The direction was generated after reviewing all 525 completed 2018-2020 parent charts. This is consumed-history development, not independent confirmation.
single_incremental_question: Does requiring the initial reclaim plus two additional consecutive completed closes above the frozen supply-event high remove one-day false reassertions without destroying annual breadth and long-payoff economics?

entry_rule.confirmation_session_1: The next market session must be PIT-valid in the same corporate-action coordinate lineage and close strictly above the frozen event high.
entry_rule.confirmation_session_2: The following market session must be PIT-valid in the same corporate-action coordinate lineage and close strictly above the frozen event high.
entry_rule.decision_at: After confirmation session 2 close and its data are available.
entry_rule.entry: First legally buyable open during the next three market sessions; never the confirmation bar.

exit_rule.unchanged_parent_failure_exit: After entry, two consecutive PIT-valid completed closes strictly below the frozen event low schedule an exit at the next legally sellable open.
exit_rule.unchanged_time_exit: Otherwise first legally sellable open at or after 120 market sessions from entry.

staged_evaluation.stage_1: Apply the frozen entry confirmation and execution contract without reading or aggregating trade returns.
staged_evaluation.breadth_gate: More than 50 completed signals in each of 2018, 2019, and 2020.
staged_evaluation.stage_2: If and only if the breadth gate passes, run one development aggregation.
annual_return_gates: mean net return greater than 4% in every development signal year
median net return greater than 0% in every development signal year
